node.statement: For c_m=binom(-1/2,m), the binomial series h(w)=sum_{m>=0}c_m w^m has radius one and is the analytic inverse-square-root branch h(w)=(1+w)^(-1/2); hence the registered power-series functional calculus represents Z^(-1/2) by sum_{m>=0}c_m(Z-I)^m whenever ||Z-I||<1.
